news.headline:
The Ramco Cements' brand Hard Worker won three Kyoorius Design Awards 2026, including the Grand Prix Grey Elephant.

Hard Worker also received two Blue Elephant honours, recognizing its design and packaging excellence, aiding ₹350 crore sales in 12 months.

Source: BSE

news.headline:
Sumeet Industries' board approved conversion of OCRPs into 84,31,195 equity shares worth Rs. 28 Cr at Rs. 33.21/share.

Shares allotted to non-promoters, including Bank of Baroda, Canara Bank, IDBI Bank, and others, post tenure expiry.

Source: BSE
